incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: GEAUi opened, but the local GEACore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart GEAUi.

incompleteInstallation.title: GEAUi installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so GEACore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest GEAUi. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined GEACore.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest GEAUi package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined GEAUi components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: GEAUi package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This GEAUi package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: GEAUi opened, but GEACore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling GEAUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: GEAUi opened, but GEACore stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling GEAUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: GEAUi opened, but GEACore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart GEAUi.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: GEAUi detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, GEAUi will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

transientConcurrentStartup.title: GEAUi is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another GEAUi startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart GEAUi.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: GEACore is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: GEACore couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry
